$comment: History-exception gate (P2-10 hardened; RETURN-2 area 6 approval model). Blob-scoped entries only — tracked files are never allowlisted; fix the file instead. Every entry pins one exact historical Git object by full 40-character id, exact repo-relative path, pattern, and exact expected occurrence count, with owner, reason, approvalStatus, expiry, and retest. approvalStatus is proposed until Kody explicitly ratifies in writing (then ratified with ratifiedOn); proposed entries still reconcile findings but the gate reports HOLD (exit 3), never approval. The gate rejects unused (orphaned), duplicate, malformed, and expired entries, and fails on occurrence-count drift. The orphaned fifth entry (c666a92f jwt-shaped-token, which never matched) was removed 2026-08-21 per the first RETURN directive.
